title: Sector
author: lukodiablo
selftext:
Imagine a metaverse where anyone can build their own world and play with friends in real-time without heavy downloads, installs, or complex configurations. You just hit "play" and start building your world.

Here's a quick look at the environment: [https://youtu.be/FSVl4DmVfG8](https://youtu.be/FSVl4DmVfG8)

To make things easier, you can optionally summon an in-game assistant named Atlas. Atlas can help you build and suggest props from an expanding library. If you can't find what you need, you can even generate your own custom 3D models using meshy directly in the game. Atlas will notify you when your generated model is ready—usually within two minutes—and you can place it right into your world!
